summary_md:
# Kæmpe Black Monday-flop

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-10-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of Store Penge, recorded on Monday 20 October 2026. It covers the sharp sell-off in AI stocks, the 'Black Monday' fear that never came true (Nasdaq rose about 1.3% that day), rising interest rates and a sticky US inflation print. Joachim Brygman expects defaults among AI infrastructure names such as Oracle, CoreWeave and smaller neoclouds before the market finds a real bottom. Both he and Mikkel Rosenvold still see AI as a good long-term investment but warn of choppy months ahead and suggest waiting. Other topics: Trump easing Russia sanctions, Tesla's flying Roadster as a possible signal of a Tesla-SpaceX merger, a listener question on Bitcoin and MicroStrategy, and the week's earnings (Meta, Tesla, Netflix, SpaceX, Lockheed Martin).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 MSTR — Strategy (MicroStrategy) | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 75%

Joachim would exit MicroStrategy at the first opportunity; he says it could go bankrupt if Bitcoin falls below ~70k.

#### Reasoning

Joachim (guest) says MicroStrategy borrows money to buy crypto, its average holding cost is around 70k, and its structures are growing more complex and less transparent. If Bitcoin drops below 70k the company risks bankruptcy. He is more positive on crypto itself, but advises getting out of MSTR on its own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Bitcoin sustains well above 80k and the balance-sheet risk falls
- if the financing structure becomes more transparent

> *"Så MicroStrategy til sig selv, den vil jeg nok bare komme ud af ved først givende lejlighed."*

---

### ⛔ ORCL — Oracle | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Joachim says Oracle is clearly in the risk zone for a default as AI infrastructure financing costs rise.

#### Reasoning

Joachim (guest) now expects defaults in the AI complex because companies spend cash now and get it back over 6-36 months, so they need debt markets. If those markets panic, they may be unable to finance operations. He names Oracle as clearly at risk and expects the market bottom only after such an event.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit spreads and financing costs ease
- if Oracle's cash flow covers its capex without new debt

> *"Oracle er jo helt sikkert i risikozoner, så er der selvfølgelig mange af de mindre neoclouds, blandt andet CoreWeave."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Short-term financing cost of ~15% in the bond market; Joachim names it among the neoclouds likely to default.

#### Reasoning

CoreWeave's short-term bond financing cost rose to about 15% amid rising rates. Joachim (guest) expects defaults among smaller neoclouds because of a cash-flow mismatch and debt-market stress. A default would be the event that marks a true bottom for the sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if bond yields and financing costs normalize
- if CoreWeave secures long-term funding

> *"CoreWeave var et eksempel her i den forgangne uges løb, hvor deres finansieringsomkostning og kortvarig SD til cirka 15% i obligationsmarkedet."*

---

### 🟢 FORTUM — Fortum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Part of Mikkel's Finland data-center theme, which has performed well since August and is not yet discovered by US investors.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel (host-side analyst) pitched Finland data centers at the August live show; Fortum has done well since then. He says US investors have not yet noticed the theme. He holds Finland exposure in his portfolio but admits he is biased toward Finland.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US investors fully price in the Finland data-center theme
- if data-center demand in Finland slows

> *"Den der fortum har kørt meget godt af. Ja, blandt andet."*

---

### 🟢 NBIS — Nebius | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Named as part of the Finland data-center theme that has paid off.

#### Reasoning

Nebius is named alongside Fortum in Mikkel's Finland data-center pitch, which he says has been worth buying since August. The broader AI sell-off and Joachim's warning on neocloud financing risk temper the view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if neocloud financing stress spreads
- if AI infrastructure demand slows

> *"Nebius og der er også et par andre, så det er noget, der breder sig derude"*

---

### 🟠 IREN — Iren | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Fell ~30% in a week without fundamental change; good long term, but hosts suggest waiting for a capitulation event.

#### Reasoning

Joachim says nothing fundamental has changed for AI stocks like Iren, but a default or forced liquidation could trigger a deeper drop, possibly 30% more. Long-term investors can start buying; risk-averse ones should wait for the market bottom.

#### Sell Triggers

- if an AI infrastructure provider defaults
- if rate hikes continue

> *"Fundamentalt set er der ikke det store, der ændrer sig"*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Joachim expects the market to now reward Meta's AI capex because its consumer agents are working.

#### Reasoning

In past quarters the market punished Meta for heavy capex. Joachim (guest) thinks Meta has now 'ramt noget' with its consumer AI agents and bots, so investors may reward aggressive spending on technology that already works. He flags the upcoming earnings report as one to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the earnings report shows capex without revenue traction

> *"Jeg synes, Meta er en af de rigtig spændende."*

---

### 🟠 NFLX — Netflix | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Time spent on Netflix is falling slightly, a leading indicator that willingness to pay will drop in later quarters.

#### Reasoning

Joachim (guest) notes a slight decline in engagement and says lower time spent typically shows up as lower willingness to pay a few quarters later.

> *"Der har man faktisk set, at det hvis nok er faldet en lille smule, og det er jo sådan en leading indicator"*

---

### 🟠 TSLA — Tesla | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Flying Roadster read as a hint of a SpaceX merger or a smokescreen before earnings; focus is robots and robotaxis, not cars.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel expects news that Tesla and SpaceX will merge. The host worries the stunt may hide weak car sales ahead of earnings. Joachim says the earnings story depends more on humanoid robots, self-driving and robotaxis than on cars.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings reveal weak car deliveries

> *"Jeg tror, man kan læse som vink med en vognstang, at Tesla og SpaceX kommer til at være samme virksomhed i den nære fremtid."*

---
